annotations.title: Find a TraderMatrix Tool for a Goal

description:
Find which TraderMatrix tool fits a goal ("see where dealers are hedging", "find
stocks breaking out", "track my wheel trades"). Use when the user describes what they
want to do and not a tool name. Returns the top 5 tools with a one-line description,
the live url to open, and the matching guide.
